occurrences.exact_quote:
| System | Count | Type | Relation to 22-core |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Phoenician/Hebrew/Aramaic** | 22 | Consonantal abjad | **The core itself** |
| **Greek** | 24 | Full alphabet (vowels added) | Derived from 22; expanded |
| **Latin** | 21–23 | Full alphabet | Derived from Greek; reduced then expanded |
| **Arabic** | 22 basic / 28 standard | Abjad (basic) with dotted expansions | Derived from the Semitic backbone; expanded |
| **Egyptian** | 24 uniliterals within ~700–2,000 signs | Mixed phonetic + logographic + determinative | **No 22-core**; 24-consonant phonetic subset inside a larger system |
| **Cuneiform** | ~600 logograms + 100–150 syllabograms | Logosyllabic | **No 22-core**; hundreds of polyvalent signs |
| **Enochian** | 21 | Constructed alphabet | **Not derived**; one short of 22; independent 16th-century system |
